indexes.//: The week's table: every player whose best belongs to this week, in time order. Firestore serves a filter and a sort on the same field by itself, but not a filter on one field and a sort on another, so this pair has to be declared. Without it the week tab answers with an error, which the game shows as 'we could not load the table'.
The same week's table read backwards, which is how the rows just ahead of a player are found when they rank below the top.
